description.value: The Dunster Station Museum is a heritage railway attraction in the small community of Dunster in BC's Robson Valley, preserving the history of the region's rail era. It operates in cooperation with a network of regional heritage institutions including the Central BC Railway & Forestry Museum and Valley Museum and Archives in nearby McBride. Cyclists touring the Robson Valley corridor between McBride and Valemount may find it a worthwhile cultural stop along the route.
